$meta.title: Companies registered in Burnley, with the insolvency practitioner addresses removed

measures.definition: Companies on the live register with a registered office in the borough
Live register companies whose status is not Active (proposal to strike off, liquidation, administration or similar)
Not active as a share of live companies

$meta.table: Free Company Data Product, held by the estate as lancs_register.csv.gz; company insolvency and filing history pages
$meta.citation: Companies House (2026) Free Company Data Product, 1 July 2026
$meta.vintage: register snapshot of 1 July 2026; quarterly refresh
$meta.caveat: A registered office is not a trading address. Two postcodes in the borough are the offices of insolvency practitioners: a company being wound up usually has its registered address moved to its liquidator's office, wherever it traded. Together they hold 504 companies, almost all of them not active; both counts are shown. No practitioner or officer is named, and there is no page per company.
$meta.rules: No person is named. Companies are named only in the largest filers panel, from their own filed accounts. No estimate is shown as fact. Derived figures carry their arithmetic.
